evidence: PDF page 33 is a production-defective page in this catalog copy: the CASPER RX table renders with the Syringe Kit's header block ('One kit per box, includes two 60cc VacLok Syringes...', columns VACLOK Spheres / Min. Catheter ID (inch) 22-60) and MVSK60 (the page-32 Syringe Kit reference) as its first data row; the printed values are impossible for a carotid stent (diameter 22-47 mm, min catheter ID up to 60 inch) and the true column meanings cannot be established from this document. Wrong is worse than absent: the family is excluded rather than served with unverifiable headers.

PDF page 5's 'HydroSoft 3D Coils' table prints the same H2HS-V reference numbers (100152H2HS-V etc., 13 shared references with identical diameter/length) as page 7's 'HydroSoft Helical Coils' table. Two orderable products cannot share reference numbers; the page-5 table is a production duplicate of the helical reference series under a 3D heading, so the 3D references cannot be verified from this document. The helical family on page 7 is retained.

PDF page 19's Scepter XC table prints reference GC695BUVT, which is a Chaperon 6F guiding catheter reference (page 18, catheter dimensions, no balloon columns). The same document's page 35 PHIL compatibility table gives the Scepter XC product code as BC0411XC. The balloon specifications on the page-19 row (balloon range 2.0-6.0 mm, length 11 mm, usable length 150 cm) are Scepter XC values; only the printed reference cell is wrong.
